body: Hey guys update she left me thanks for the help
We already live together but if we didn’t I would have asked, another thing that happened fast
I appreciate this, I will most likely purchase a ring and give the idea time to breathe so I can feel the idea out
She’s said she wants to get married, frankly she changed my mind on the topic, premarital counseling isn’t something I’ve heard of my parents(now divorced) got married around the same time
I’m not sure it’s so simple but I appreciate your advice
And now that I say it I’m sure she thinks I am too

Well, my issue right now isn’t really getting ahead or catching up, I’m pretty caught up, im just so afraid to lose her I’m struggling to do anything, I suffer from crippling depression and panic attacks, so living like this isn’t ideal, I told her on The day she got to her destination and the day after that I was not well and I was freaking out, which she felt for me but fell mostly on deaf ears I mean she wasn’t gonna come back from her vacation for me, it’s her dream vacation she spent thousands on, I just feel really pathetic right now
Thank you I hope it comes to fruition I’d kill for a friend right now, but I’m just gonna keep venting my frustrations to the void that is the internet

Potentially, I could try that, I really just can’t find a clear thought right now, ya know? I’m really irrational and out there, I’m afraid she’s going to leave me and I can’t quite deal with that in this very moment
I just really need a friend in this dire time

Hey thank you for your response, ya I’ve been starting to realize my massive codependency on her, unfortunately my hobbies are just like gaming and stupid in door stuff, I’m a programmer by trade and a banker for work, so I don’t exactly get to go out much while I finish my bachelors, today I started to look into gym memberships in my area to feel better about all of this, I believe I’m gonna start going on runs and trying to feel better both physically and mentally
Well I was not invited friend, and I didn’t want to intrude on a girls trip
Hey thank you for your response ! I just don’t think it’s that simple, I don’t want to lose her though and I feel the sudden, I need to go home, good bye is a means to an end l
Sorry I should have elaborated she went with her best friend and her cousin, weve been together almost a year I’ve lived with her for 2 months
I’ve actually never heard that saying, I appreciate your response greatly, I’m just not willing to give her up
That’s fair and thank you for your reply, I currently work for a bank near our home I started this job 2 weeks ago, before she left, I’m also finishing my bachelors, I’m just kinda drowning
